title: BoBDeLaN: Bounded-Bandwidth Context Adaptation for Deep Lagrangian Robot Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.21209v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned physics-based models provide structure for robot control, but uncertain payloads and unmodeled dynamics limit their predictive accuracy. Context-aware Deep Lagrangian Networks enable adaptation through a latent context inferred from measurement histories while retaining Lagrangian structure for each fixed context. However, this structure alone does not constrain sensitivity to measurement disturbances. We introduce BoBDeLaN, which combines a contracting, gain-bounded Recurrent Equilibrium Network context encoder with stable linear filtering to shape disturbance sensitivity across frequencies. This architecture guarantees exponential forgetting of the recurrent initialization and admits a finite-horizon, frequency-weighted bound on context perturbations, which extends to residual torque prediction under a Lipschitz continuity assumption on the context-conditioned dynamics model. translated_title: BoBDeLaN：面向深度拉格朗日机器人控制的受限带宽上下文自适应
translated_abstract: 基于物理的学习模型为机器人控制提供了结构化的框架，但不确定的负载和未建模的动态限制了其预测精度。上下文感知的深度拉格朗日网络通过从测量历史中推断出的潜在上下文实现自适应调整，同时对每个固定的上下文保持拉格朗日结构。然而，仅凭这种结构并不能约束对测量扰动的敏感性。我们提出了BoBDeLaN，它将收缩的、增益有界的递归平衡网络上下文编码器与稳定的线性滤波相结合，以在不同频率范围内塑造对扰动的敏感性。该架构保证了递归初始化的指数遗忘特性，并给出了有限时域内频率加权的上下文扰动界；在上下文条件化的动力学模型满足Lipschitz连续性假设的前提下，该界可进一步推广至残差力矩预测。我们在模型预测控制实验中评估了一种低通滤波实现（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: BoBDeLaN通过将增益有界的收缩型递归平衡网络上下文编码器与稳定线性滤波相结合，为深度拉格朗日网络的自适应机器人控制提供了对测量扰动敏感性的有限时域频率加权界保证。
en_tdlr: BoBDeLaN combines a contracting, gain-bounded Recurrent Equilibrium Network context encoder with stable linear filtering to provide finite-horizon, frequency-weighted bounds on disturbance sensitivity for context-adaptive Deep Lagrangian Network robot control.
